name: Niger national Tier III data center (DTS), PK5 Niamey
developer: Government of Niger (Ministry of Communication, New Information Technologies / MCNTI; ANSI) financed by African Development Bank (AfDB) under Trans-Sahara Optical Fibre Backbone project P-Z1-GB0-024
notes: National Tier III data center under the AfDB-supported DTS project: ANP (2025-02-27) reported minister announcement of AfDB support >9bn FCFA, 13% execution, planned reception 2025-09-30; WeAreTech (fr) confirms ~14.3M USD cost and 13% completion; AfDB 2025-11-21 press release lists installation of the Tier III national data centre as core component and 88 km Niamey urban loop connecting administrative sites; Air Info Agadez (2025-02-27) corroborates; BNEE EIES report locates the project at PK5, Arrondissement Communal Niamey V. No public reception/inauguration news found by 2026-08-12 (Sep-2025 target passed unconfirmed); Tier III claim not Uptime-certified (C/U). No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Ministry of Finance (DGMG) data center procurement
developer: Government of Niger - Direction Générale de la Modernisation de la Gestion (DGMG); awarded to Groupe BASSID SERVICES
notes: Government internal data center line: NE methodology records official procurement plan P_MF_2022_5 (server-room shell, internal cabling, IT equipment, pilot room) with provisional award TR_DGMG_034 dated 2021-07-27 to Groupe BASSID SERVICES on the national procurement portal marchespublics.ne (portal re-verified reachable 2026-08-12; the specific 2021 tender page is not directly re-fetched). Location most likely Niamey (central government procurement); operational status and precise address unverified (U). Recorded as government internal DC, not commercial colocation.

name: Airtel Niger Zinder data center phase
notes: Airtel Niger's USD 5.7M Zinder-Maimoujia project (works launched 2021-08-20 per Le Sahel; announced Aug 2021) planned as phases: 12 km urban fibre loop in Zinder, construction of a data center in the city (phase 2), and 123 km link to Maimoujia at the Nigeria border (phase 3). Developing Telecoms, Construction Review Online and TechAfrica News corroborate the route and the data center phase. No evidence of data center completion/fit-out found as of 2026-08-12; treated as announced/planned. Note: Airtel Africa's operational DCs are in Lagos, Nigeria - not counted for NE.
